reason: With 1,350 members, most over 60, and 27 holes of tee sheet, I can't hang the whole operation on two founders whose first club isn't even live yet. The free pilot is nice, but running it alongside our current system is still extra work for me and my front desk, and I'd rather not be the second guinea pig.
objection: Our older members will not install a new app, and if they get stuck the calls land on my desk, not on a helpline that stops after four weeks. On top of that, two founders is a lot of risk for the system that runs our tee times and invoices.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle live for a full season, its board telling me on the phone that their over-60 members actually use it and the club's workload went down, not up.
